environment.app: Genesis UI (3D scene) served by Vite on port 3001

steps.action: Open the app in the Cloud browser
Send 'My studio project is called Aurelia — a jewellery brand with a rose gold signature.' through the chat composer
steps.evidence: reply: 'Right — so Aurelia, rose-gold jewellery. What part of the brand are you looking to develop…'; message stored in the conversation (8 messages after)

steps.action: Create a new conversation and make it the workspace's active conversation
steps.evidence: store reports title 'M22.1 — studio project', active id 36143ce9…, chats persisted (4 chats, 11295 chars)

steps.action: Reload the page and continue in the restored chat
Ask 'What's the status of the Aurelia project?' in a different chat after reload and confirm a labelled historical recall
steps.pipelineEvidence: MISSION-22.1/provider-validation.json — both providers answered with the fact present and labelled, user B's payload clean

steps.action: Ask 'Can you fix it?' in a new chat and confirm the grief from the earlier chat does not appear
steps.result: verified in M22 (screenshots), not re-run this session

blockers.detail: OpenRouter free-model daily limit exhausted (HTTP 429 'free-models-per-day') and Groq TPM 8000 exceeded (413/429) after the live validation runs. The UI turn could reach the pipeline but no model reply could be generated.

After ~2 minutes the Cloud browser's CDP connection and accessibility tree time out; Playwright could no longer attach (connectOverCDP timeout), and an evaluation that imports a module exceeded 10 s. A fresh tab booted to an empty root while Vite returned 503s during dependency re-optimisation.
blockers.classification: tooling limit, documented in M22 and unchanged
